text:
Aimee Lindner This sounds incredibly frustrating and I'm sorry no one has a sure solution for you. From my perspective, I believe you can only keep trying to submit both digitally and online, as well as keep a record of all your attempts. Especially if your lawyer, who you seem happy with and has secured big wins for you earlier in the process, has no other ideas.

I would maybe make another post to ask if anyone else has not been able to submit online recently. I would have expected to see more posts about it if it is a global system issue. Share a picture of the error message or whatever results when you try to submit.

Maybe there is a technical solution. Seems absurd to recommend at this point, but did you try different browsers? 😅
